# Kodra

> One-command Azure developer environment for Ubuntu Desktop & WSL2

Kodra transforms a fresh Ubuntu 24.04+ install (or WSL2) into a fully-configured Azure cloud-native development workstation in minutes. One unified website with a platform toggle for both Ubuntu Desktop and WSL2. Built by [Code To Cloud Inc.](https://www.codetocloud.io)

## Quick Start

### Ubuntu Desktop
```bash
wget -qO- https://kodra.codetocloud.io/boot.sh | bash
```

### WSL2 (Windows)
```bash
wget -qO- https://kodra.wsl.codetocloud.io/boot.sh | bash
```

## What Kodra Installs

- Azure CLI, Azure Developer CLI (azd), Bicep, Terraform, OpenTofu
- GitHub CLI with Copilot CLI for AI-powered terminal workflows
- Docker CE, lazydocker, Dev Containers support
- Kubernetes: kubectl, Helm, k9s
- Modern terminal: Ghostty (Desktop) / Windows Terminal (WSL), Starship prompt, Nerd Fonts
- VS Code with Tokyo Night theme and 15 cloud-native extensions
- CLI tools: bat, eza, fzf, ripgrep, zoxide, btop, fastfetch, jq, yq
- Git: lazygit, GitLens, GitHub Desktop
- Desktop (Ubuntu only): ULauncher, window tiling, blur effects, macOS-style dock

## Key Commands

- `kodra theme` — Switch themes (tokyo-night, ghostty-blue, catppuccin, gruvbox, nord, rose-pine)
- `kodra doctor` — Check system health
- `kodra update` — Update everything
- `kodra dev` — Install language runtimes (node, python, go)
- `kodra db` — Start database containers (postgres, mysql, redis)
- `kodra install` — Install additional applications
- `kodra repair` — Re-apply all configs without reinstalling
